authoring: Written on 24 November 2026 by an agent against the rubric in the README, from public words only. Green Goods and Tech and Sun use their owners' public-safe profile text (the same as fund-relevance-owner-v1.json) and their public repositories; every other initiative is a real public Certified project in packages/api/evaluation/partner-real-v1-corpus.json or fund-ranking-v1.json. Each pair says why it must or must not match in the PRD's terms: which need meets which offer or capability, the kind of support, the field of work and the place.

initiatives.name: Green Goods
initiatives.description: Green Goods is an open-source app that helps community groups plan, record and review their regenerative work, such as planting trees, sorting waste, keeping solar panels running or teaching classes. Members log the work with photos, offline or by chat, and the people it served confirm it was done. That shared record helps supporters see what happened and fund what comes next.

initiatives.name: Tech and Sun
initiatives.description: Tech and Sun builds free, solar-powered hubs in Nigeria where students, creatives and builders get steady power, internet and a place to learn and work. Our first hub is a converted shipping container at Nnamdi Azikiwe University in Awka. We run workshops on digital skills, Web3 and climate, and we share our hub design as an open blueprint so other communities can build their own.

funds.reason: Tech and Sun's field is energy access (free solar-powered hubs) and it works in Nigeria. All On, ROGEAP and REA's DARES fund off-grid and solar energy access in programs that name Nigeria; EKOenergy funds community solar in low- and middle-income countries. Financial capital for the field and place it works in.
Keyword traps. The hub gives people internet, but internet freedom (censorship and surveillance) is not its field. CEA-LAT is for one California ZIP code and Floresta Viva for one Brazilian basin.

An open-source app whose reviewed work becomes an onchain record is an Ethereum public good: Gitcoin Grants and the Ecosystem Support Program fund open-source public goods on Ethereum, and Filecoin Open Grants fund open developer tools on decentralized infrastructure. These are the ecosystem grants the PRD's tooling builder looks for.
NGI Zero Commons funds digital commons, which Green Goods is, but it names neither Ethereum nor regeneration and its final call has closed. Expected among the Good fits, reported rather than gated.
Green Goods names solar panels only as an example of the work its users record. It is not an energy project, so energy-access programs must not fill its first ten.

Free permaculture courses in Spanish: farming and food, regeneration and education. The Global Food System Challenge funds regenerative food systems. Early-childhood programs share only the word education.
A sensory garden that keeps ancestral Amazonian knowledge of medicinal plants and receives schools. It works with schools; it is not early-childhood development.
A Colombian reserve restoring Andean forest. Floresta Viva shares restoration and water but names only Brazil's São Francisco basin, so it is a caution, not a first-ten fit.
A traceability platform for circular supply chains; the Milken-Motsepe prize funds circular-economy solutions.
Maasai women artisans restoring Indigenous forest: Indigenous women, culture and forests. FIMI's AYNI small grants fund Indigenous women's initiatives.
Watershed restoration in California; the Urban Streams Restoration Program funds stream and watershed restoration in California.
Community-led biodiversity monitoring in Taraba State, Nigeria; the GEF Small Grants Programme's Nigeria window funds community conservation there.

programs.reason: A funder reading for fitting initiatives: an off-grid energy challenge in Nigeria fits the Nigerian solar hub before anyone else.
Ethereum public goods fit the open-source app with onchain records first.
A circular-economy prize fits the circular supply-chain platform first.
An Indigenous women's fund fits the Maasai women artisans first.

Recording community work is not making bioacoustic recordings: projects that deploy AudioMoth sensors, track urban wildlife or survey a hornbill's range would not use Green Goods' app. The word matcher put Bioacoustic Echoes of Stewardship first here, on the words open and community.

Species surveys are research, not communities doing regenerative work that would pilot a work-recording app. The word matcher put an AI acoustic survey of turtle doves third here, on the word communities.

Money to keep the hub running is financial capital only; no public project in the corpus says it funds others, so nothing may be offered as a capability. The word matcher found nothing here either: this pair guards the rule, it does not show a fix.

Desk space in Awka is offered here only: whoever uses it must be in Nigeria, and the Nigerian projects in the corpus (in Anambra, Delta and Taraba States) could use it. Nothing suggested is not a pass.
Money for development is financial capital only. The word matcher offered five projects that only shared the word community.
